blurb: Amherst Ballet offers quality dance instruction through performances, educational programming, and community partnerships. Training is individualized, focusing on both technique and expressivity, informed by Vaganova, Balanchine, Cechetti, and ABT methods. The program centers on dancer's emotional and physical health, supporting both avocational and pre-professional dancers.
